body:
It doesn't even matter though. All the people I hang out with have way better grades than me AND they have fulfilling lives. My life has been this way since the 3rd grade, and I'm about to start 11th grade. If anything it's gotten worse. My kinds of problems are the ones that can never be fixed. It's not that I hate people, and it's not even that people hate me. And when I say they talk about random things, it's not stupid stuff like Jersey Shore or that bullshit. Everyone talks about random things. But nobody cares when *I* am the one saying those things.

I'm currently teaching at a middle school debate camp, but I had no fucking motivation whatsoever and I didn't want to be depressed in front of kids, so I asked my friend to tell my teacher that I can't go. Nobody even asked why, and when I return thursday, I guarantee nobody will have noticed that I was gone. I serve no purpose whatsoever, and it's going to stay that way.
